title: Part Seven: The Deal and Its Killing

sections.brief: The 2013 Joint Plan of Action; the JCPOA's limits and sunsets; Resolution 2231; Netanyahu's 2015 Congress speech and the Boehner invitation; the WSJ spying report and Israel's denial; AIPAC/CNFI and J Street campaigns (reported spend); the failed Senate vote; IAEA verification 2016-2019. Figures: time

The 30 April 2018 archive presentation and the IAEA/US/European/Iranian responses; Trump's 8 May 2018 withdrawal; maximum pressure; Iran's dated breaches from May 2019 and its stated reason; Vienna talks and 2025 snapback; JCPOA limits vs IAEA May 2025; former Israeli security chiefs and Biden on the withdrawal, with the decision-makers' case. Figures: flow; compare
